task.title: Bound synchronous lifecycle projection-store operations
task.head_binding: The reviewer must bind this committed manifest to the exact final PR head in the canonical approve command.

not_changing: Source Ingestion polling (remains reconcile-only / manual-pull only, MAX_TICKS=0)
Quarantine and receipt claiming relational semantics
Public telemetry schema and event contracts

contracts.synchronous_store_bounds: ProjectionStore implements finite positive connect_timeout_seconds, statement_timeout_seconds, and lock_timeout_seconds (defaulting to 10.0s), configuring PostgreSQL libpq connect_timeout and session options statement_timeout and lock_timeout at connection initialization and falling back to connection-level SET queries on custom connectors.
contracts.timeout_configuration: _configured_relational_projector binds environment variables LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_PROJECTION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_PROJECTION_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_PROJECTION_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, and LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_PROJECTION_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (with fallback to LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_DB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS or 10.0s), rejecting non-finite, non-positive, or boolean inputs.
contracts.worker_resilience: Lifecycle worker catches synchronous query/lock/connect timeouts during startup and batch execution, publishing failure/degraded status to the durable controller via _record_worker_failure without process hanging or deadlock.

validation.coverage: ProjectionStore timeout configuration, connect timeout failure within deadline, connect timeout option forwarding, statement timeout cancellation via QueryCanceled, lock timeout cancellation via LockNotAvailable, custom connector fallback, relational projector timeout environment variable binding, and worker timeout recovery with durable failure mutation and no premature checkpoint advance
Trade Journey BFF readiness checks, contract schemas, and read API endpoints

validation_environment.note: Auto-worker environments must run scripts/dev/provision_python_distribution.py before executing pytest suites.

verify positive and negative connect, statement, and lock timeout test coverage in services/trade_journey/test_projection_store.py and services/trade_journey/test_lifecycle_projector.py
verify full pytest suite passes using provisioned interpreter .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 and live postgres instance
